newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine '96 final refined sugar output 3.26 mln T.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine '96 final refined sugar output 3.26 mln T.

text.p: Ukraine's total refined sugar output fell to 3.26 million tonnes last year from 3.49 million tonnes in 1995, a senior agriculture ministry official said on Monday.

Leonid Svatkov, head of the ministry's Food Industry Committee, told Reuters Ukraine refined sugar output from the 1996 beet crop totalled 2.70 million tonnes and Ukraine produced 561,000 of whites from imported raws earlier in the year.
Svatkov said a Russian quota imposed in December limiting imports of Ukrainian white sugar to 1.15 million tonnes, in response to what Russian says is sugar dumping, was hurting Ukraine.
"Ukraine export potential is about 1.5 million tonnes of whites, but unfortunately we are losing our traditional markets," Svatkov said.
Russia is Ukraine's primary sugar market, though Ukraine also expects to export sugar to Belarus, Kazakhstan and the Baltic countries.
Ukraine was interested in exporting sugar to ease pressures on the domestic market, Svatkov added.
President Leonid Kuchma last week at a meeting with government officials expressed concern over a lack of clear state policy on the sugar market.

Ukrainian domestic sugar prices have dropped over the past month because the market was flooded with sugar for sale by cash-poor farms and refineries. Many refinery workers and farmers were being paid with sugar.
Svatkov said refined sugar was selling at 520 hryvnias ($276) per tonne on the local market. In 1995 sugar fetched $450-460 per tonne.
Industry officials forecast that the situation on the sugar market could result in the closure of many of the 191 Ukrainian refineries by the end of the year.
An industry official said in December that only 30 sugar refineries were operating.
Ukraine harvested only 24 million tonnes of sugar beet in 1996 against 30 million tonnes in 1995.
Average yields stood at 19.9 tonnes per hectare, compared with 22.2 tonnes in 1995.
Kiev's forecast at the beginning of the summer for the 1996 beet harvest was 27 million tonnes.
The government blamed drought in the spring and summer, although the agriculture sector also suffered from shortages of fuel, equipment, pesticides and herbicides.
In the late 1980s Ukraine produced about five million tonnes of refined sugar annually.
